cases.name: Nhật Nguyệt Tịnh Minh
cases.runtimeNote: SHA-256 of https://tuvithuchanh.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Tu-vi-dau-so.pdf matches the registry 941b104504dd552fe967354759da1683dda30a529aa59a8e570b05727f5b4458. Printed page 230, PDF index 229. The text layer encodes the Sun position as U+0054 U+00FD (Tý). The rendered glyph has a detached dot below the y, the same shape as page 71 words whose text layer is U+1EF5 (Tỵ). On page 71, U+00FD in lý has an acute and no dot below, so the font can draw both. This is a text-layer mismatch, not a 1956-edition proof. The stored span was not rewritten. Visual first clause is Sửu / Sun Tỵ / Moon Hợi. That Sun/Moon pair is not produced by the current placer. Quách Ngọc Bội, fetched 2026-10-13, says the book wrote Hợi by mistake and the Moon should be Dậu. Page 71 labels a separate illustration Nhật Tỵ Nguyệt Dậu at Sửu, and another illustration on the same page puts Sun Mão and Moon Hợi at Sửu. Those are not one rule. Editorial Sửu / Tỵ / Dậu is reachable at can=0,chi=0,day=14,month=2,hour=3. Clause 2 Mùi / Mão / Hợi is reachable at can=0,chi=0,day=1,month=2,hour=9. rulesV2 allows Sun Tị or Ngọ and Moon Dậu or Tí, so it covers the editorial pair and also other mixtures, and it does not implement clause 2. Original decision stays CONFLICT. expertVerified remains false.

Printed page 230, PDF index 229. The text layer encodes the Sun position as U+0054 U+00FD (Tý). The rendered glyph has a detached dot below the y, the same shape as page 71 words whose text layer is U+1EF5 (Tỵ). On page 71, U+00FD in lý has an acute and no dot below, so the font can draw both. This is a text-layer mismatch, not a 1956-edition proof. The stored span was not rewritten. Visual first clause Sửu / Sun Tỵ / Moon Hợi is unreachable.
